title: Administrator
description:
Administrator - Immediate Start Stoke-on-Trent

About the Opportunity

RHA Recruitment Solutions are proud to be supporting a well-established and growing engineering business based in Stoke on Trent, in the search for a highly organised and proactive Administrator.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced administration professional who enjoys being at the centre of a busy operation, supporting multiple departments and helping keep business processes running smoothly. We are looking for someone who naturally takes ownership, thinks ahead, anticipates business needs, and enjoys working collaboratively within a professional team environment.

The successful candidate will become a key part of the business, providing vital administrative support across a variety of functions including office coordination, document management, reporting, diary management, communications and operational support.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing incoming telephone calls and responding to emails professionally and efficiently.
- Processing purchase orders and maintaining accurate records.
- Producing reports (internal and external) and supporting management with administrative tasks.
- Creating, updating and maintaining business documents and correspondence whilst aintaining organised electronic and hard-copy filing systems.
- Coordinating diaries, meetings and appointments for management teams.
- Arranging travel, accommodation and associated logistics when required.
- Supporting the management of office and operational supplies.
- Ensuring documentation is stored, controlled and maintained in line with company procedures.
- Liaising effectively with suppliers, customers and internal departments.
- Providing general administrative support to support business operations.
- Identifying opportunities to improve administrative processes and efficiency.

What We're Looking For

We are keen to speak with candidates who are:
- Proactive and forward-thinking in their approach, highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
- Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong communicators who can confidently collaborate across all levels of the business.
- Professional, dependable and able to work with minimal supervision.
- Confident using Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel and Outlook.
- Experienced in administration, office support or business support roles.
- Experiene of proof reading, report writing and Microsoft Office (incl PowerPoint)
- Able to demonstrate strong document-writing and organisational skills.

Desirable Skills

While not essential, candidates with experience in the following will be at an advantage:
- Stock control and inventory management.
- Purchasing administration.
- Engineering or manufacturing sector experience.
- Working with ERP, MRP or stock management systems.

What's on Offer?
- Permanent - Monday to Friday position.
- Working for a people focused business
- Stable and growing engineering business, offering a supportive and collaborative working environment
- Opportunity to become a key member of the team.
- Varied and engaging role with long-term career potential.
- Competitive salary and benefits package.

Why Apply?

If you are an organised and proactive Administrator who enjoys taking ownership, supporting teams and making a real impact on business operations, we would love to hear from you.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Payroll Administrator (Part-time, 30 hours)

Are you tired of following old-fashioned, antiquated and outdated processes?

Are you looking for a business that will welcome a forward thinking and modern approach?

If you have answered YES, then you need to READ ON

This world leading manufacturing business based in Stoke on Trent offers its iconic products and design options and currently ship their products to over 100 countries across the globe.

I am supporting this business with the recruitment of a Payroll Administrator on a part-time basis to join a thriving, successful and growing business and supporting the Payroll Manager to take the payroll process to the next level.

You will be a key part of the HR & Payroll Team, ensuring all employees are paid accurately, carrying out daily payroll tasks and working as a small team of 3 in Payroll with all deadlines and year-end tasks.

Investing heavily in its people this business offers an incredible benefits package including; 25 days holiday + bank holidays, increased pension contributions, life insurance and support with healthcare.

What we need from you?
- Ensuring all employees are paid accurately and adhering to the pay deadlines across the 5 payrolls.
- Processing weekly and monthly payrolls that are extensive with varying pay rules, circa 800 employees.
- Carry out daily payroll tasks such as checking all clocking's monthly, holiday calculation, applying deductions and processing statutory payments.
- Ensuring all reporting is done in a timely manner.
- Supporting the Payroll Manager with all deadlines and Year End tasks.
- Ensure that all employee queries are dealt with in a timely and accurate manner.
- Put accurate information onto the system and support the Payroll manager in any additional information that may be required.
- Maintain accurate records for Starters and Leavers on the Payroll and T&A systems.
- Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of relevant legislation.
- Administer pension arrangements through the specific provider.
- Minimum 2 years working within a similar role - which should include multiple payrolls, with varying rules.

Essential Details

Position - Payroll Administrator

Permanent - Part Time 30 hours per week (4 days or spread over 5 days)

Location - Stoke on Trent

Salary - £22,400 pro rata salary (FTE £28k) + incredible benefits package
